tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Searches a directory of real small local businesses in Europe whose details were confirmed by their owners. The query is the customer's own words, e.g. 'property management in Alicante' or 'online QA course'. Returns up to five close matches with name, short description, city, an online flag, service languages, a relevance score and the page URL. The directory is small: an empty result means the directory has no such business. Each result includes the business's city and an online flag; a business located in another city is not a local match.

city.description: City the customer named (e.g. 'Alicante'). Keeps only businesses located there. Not needed when the customer wants an online service.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Returns the full public card of one business by its slug (taken from search results or from a laspi.pro/b/{slug} address): description, services, public contacts, city and service languages, as confirmed by the owner. Returns an error when there is no such business.

language.description: Preferred language of the card text (ISO code). The card comes in this language when the owner published one, otherwise in English, otherwise in the owner's own language; `card_language` says which.

tools.name: ask_directory
tools.description: Answers a customer question asked in natural language, for when the customer describes a need rather than a search term. Returns cards of the businesses that genuinely answer it, chosen strictly from the directory and never invented, with links to their pages. An empty list means the directory has no business for this need.
